content: The provided text is a detailed list of drug interactions involving drospirenone and other medications, focusing on their effects on hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism, as well as other pharmacodynamic and pharmacokinetic mechanisms. 1. The combination of umeclidinium bromide/vilanterol inhaled with drospirenone may result in increased levels or effects of the former due to alterations in CYP3A4-mediated hepatic and intestinal metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is currently unknown. 2. Drospirenone may elevate the levels or effects of upadacitinib by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical relevance of this interaction remains uncertain. 3. Drospirenone can increase the levels or effects of valbenazine through its impact on CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is not well established. 4.
